notes: Per-row script versions retained; completed checkpoints reused across harness-only retries.
Initial baseline DPR 1, remaining DPR 0.5; CSS viewport/pointer dimensions unchanged.
Six main profiles continuous rendering; added boundary/HUD checks pause drawing in final harness.
Mode/HUD fixture setup may use mouse; actual D-pad input is touch on coarse/hybrid and mouse on mouse-only.
Raw touch Atlas tap after joystick produced down/up but no click on old phone and corrected tablet. Not certified or fixed; failed traces retained.
Tap-to-walk records contain actual touch click events rejected by the original explicit guard, plus a mouse-click positive control.
Old 59-job gameplay matrix remains on b0; no broad matrix replay on the CSS-only candidate.
